name: kibitz
description: Serverless peer-to-peer video calls for any static website — battle-tested WebRTC mesh extracted from a production card-game app

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build -c vite.widget.config.ts && cp dist-widget/widget.js dist/widget.js && vite build -c vite.prerender.config.ts && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/render-docs.mjs && node scripts/gen-llms.mjs
scripts.mirror: npm run build && npx -y wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788 --kv OTP_KV
scripts.e2e:roster: node e2e/roster-multiuser.mjs && node e2e/host-migration.mjs && node e2e/cross-origin.mjs && node e2e/media-audio.mjs && node e2e/live-online.mjs
scripts.e2e:media: node e2e/online-call.mjs && node e2e/reconnect-churn.mjs && node e2e/media-recover.mjs && node e2e/media-pc-killed.mjs && node e2e/idle-after-leave.mjs
scripts.e2e:media:live: BASE=${BASE:-https://kibitz.chat} node e2e/media-audio.mjs && BASE=${BASE:-https://kibitz.chat} node e2e/host-migration.mjs && BASE=${BASE:-https://kibitz.chat} node e2e/media-relay.mjs
